meta.name: FyAgent Deep Blue-Gray Frosted Control Plane v4
meta.description: Reference-faithful dark blue-gray frosted-glass desktop control plane grounded in current FyAgent frontend data contracts.

color.palette_type: cool blue-gray monochromatic with restrained cyan and amber semantics

primary.role: the single primary action and first-level selected state

secondary.role: active connection or current-state signal only

neutral.usage: deep blue-gray canvas and panes with warm off-white text; no pure black or pure white

color.contrast_strategy: primary, secondary, and tertiary text remain WCAG AA over their opaque surface fallbacks; borders stay dimmer than text

font_families.heading: SF Pro Display, PingFang SC, Segoe UI Variable, Microsoft YaHei UI, sans-serif
font_families.body: SF Pro Text, PingFang SC, Segoe UI Variable, Microsoft YaHei UI, sans-serif
font_families.mono: SFMono-Regular, Cascadia Code, JetBrains Mono, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: native cross-platform desktop rhythm; only 400, 600, and 650 weights; no body text below 14px

spacing.section_rhythm: 20px shell inset, 16px pane gap, 20px pane padding, 56–64px list rows

layout.grid_system: shared desktop shell with a 240px object list, fluid workspace, and 280px inspector
layout.alignment_tendency: strict left alignment, centered first-level navigation, inspector fixed to the right

shape.border_usage: rgba(206,224,240,.18) for normal panes; #70BEFF only on the current row/focus
shape.divider_style: rgba(216,232,244,.18) hairlines inside continuous lists and tables

elevation.shadow_style: soft deep-blue shadow plus one top inner highlight
elevation.depth_cues: canvas, shell, pane, and strong field surfaces; never nested blur on every row

iconography.style: functional rounded outline icons plus the filled cyan Y mark
iconography.preferred_set: existing FyAgent provider/application icons and Lucide-style controls

components.button_style: 40px solid signal-blue primary pill; 36–40px translucent outlined secondary controls
components.input_style: deep paneStrong field, one subtle border, off-white value and visible placeholder hierarchy
components.card_style: one pane per functional region; list rows remain continuous rather than floating cards
components.modal_style: deeper #172F43 surface with the same field hierarchy
components.list_style: 56–64px contiguous rows with divider; selected row #245A88 and #70BEFF edge
components.inspector_style: single darker right pane with status at top, context in the middle, actions near the bottom
components.window_controls: Windows 46x40 controls at upper-right; macOS native transparent/vibrancy titlebar outside shared content

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a controlled glass instrument panel suspended over deep blue atmosphere

visual_language.ornamentation: very low; ambient fog and inner highlights only
visual_language.whitespace_usage: compact continuous lists and generous central working surfaces
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: navigation and left selection lead into one central task, with a quieter right inspector
visual_language.focal_strategy: one selected navigation item, one selected row, and one primary action
visual_language.contrast_level: high text contrast over medium-low surface contrast
visual_language.texture_usage: frosted blur without grain, particles, or decorative noise

composition.hierarchy_method: surface depth, type scale, dividers, and restrained signal color
composition.flow_direction: top navigation, left selection, center edit/inspect, right state/actions
composition.grouping_strategy: real object fields and states, not generic capability cards
composition.negative_space_role: protects the main work area and separates state from edit controls

imagery.graphic_elements: Y gate identity, hairline dividers, subtle ambient fog

interaction_feel.feedback_style: selection tint, focus edge, switch state, and concise status pill
interaction_feel.loading_style: small inline spinner where existing operations load

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: state the missing object and the next real action

overview.fallback_strategy: opaque #1D374D shell, #27465E panes, and #213F56 fields with unchanged hierarchy
overview.primary_technology: CSS backdrop-filter, alpha surfaces, and restrained gradients

background_effects.description: one faint top-left blue field and a darker bottom-right field; never a saturated marketing gradient

params.border_treatment: one low-alpha blue-white hairline and a top inner highlight

visual_effects.composite_notes: The reference's darker blue glass is combined with v3's three-pane information architecture. Material depth supports the data hierarchy; it is not applied to every row as decoration.
